title: Sting & Darby Allin: the final run
summary: Sting finds a new partner in Darby Allin and closes his wrestling run with an undefeated AEW record.

chapters.title: Sting arrives in AEW
chapters.result: Sting appears after Team Taz attack Darby and his allies.
chapters.context: His arrival begins the connection with Darby Allin.

chapters.title: The partnership enters the ring
chapters.result: Sting and Darby defeat Brian Cage and Ricky Starks in a street fight.
chapters.context: The cinematic match establishes the new team.

chapters.title: Sting’s farewell match
chapters.result: Sting and Darby retain the tag titles against the Young Bucks.
chapters.context: The match concludes Sting’s advertised final wrestling run.
